verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents loading from databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob), with setup docs such as S3 secrets. It also documents a dbt-duckdb adapter integration for transformation. Nothing in the pack shows connectors for SaaS applications or partner ETL/ELT ingestion tools, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: documented SaaS-app connectors, ETL/ELT partner connector setup (e.g. managed ingestion tools), breadth of database coverage beyond Postgres/MySQL, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, first-party and partner connectors cover my sources — SaaS apps, databases, and ETL/ELT tools — with documented setup
